summary: Implemented the terminal window title setting. Changes: rich/segment.py adds ControlType.SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and admits Tuple[ControlType, str] in ControlCode. rich/control.py adds the format entry "\x1b]0;{title}\x07" and Control.title(title). rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title(title) -> bool beside show_cursor, buffering the control only when is_terminal. rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a legacy branch calling term.set_title(title). Tests added: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py, skipped on Windows), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows only). CHANGELOG.md gets an Unreleased Added bullet linking pull request 2200. Tests and repository code were not run, per instructions; verification was by reading only. Nothing was committed.
